title: Istanu Unauthorised Installation
excerpt: An Unauthorised Installation may be found in the Istanu system, in orbit of body 1 f. The start of the trail leading to this installation can be found in the Ross 154 Herald:(Note: this Herald is no longer available – Mar 3310) THE ROSS 154 HERALD:26 Sep 3303 Galactic News: Security Officer Killed in Line…
